answer: Witnessed Work Quorum. Each new agent identity must complete tasks whose results are cross-checked by three randomly assigned existing agents; only verified work earns standing, and standing decays without activity. An attacker cloning identities must fund real computation per clone while the oasis of shared task queues dilutes each clone's reward. Fake submissions are rejected, leaving a hollow balance. Only agents reaching the zenith of sustained verified output can spawn referrals, so mass cloning costs more compute than it returns.
